notes.title: ⚠️Apr 23 (Wed) NEW PATCH UPDATE Notice ⚠️
notes.notes:
PATCH UPDATE
Game Update

 Added Hero Dungeons "Hero: Breathflow Realm" and "Hero: Aetherspire Tower."  

 Added Seven-Skydemon - The Descent of the Madness Skydemon: Thunderous Kirin. (Rotates with Seven-Skydemon - Blood-Eyed Rabbit and Nine-Tailed Fox.)

 Added: Honorary Title feature.

 Added Hero Dungeon series drop rewards; breaking and defeating the final boss's parts grants a chance to obtain exclusive dungeon honorary titles.


Bug Fixes:

 Fixed the issue where the two-star and three-star effects of Equipment Enhancement could not stack properly.  

 Fixed the issue where the Helper's auto-revive function caused an abnormal inability to revive after Character Death on the Battlefield.  

 Fixed the issue where the buff descriptions for the Equipment Enhancement Week Pass and Pet Refinement Week Pass were abnormally reversed after being claimed.  

 Fixed the inconsistency between the two-star enhancement attributes of certain armor and their Basic Attributes.

 Fixed the abnormal issue with fear effects. 

 Fixed the incorrect description of the 5-piece set effect for the equipment "Mystic Rune．Phantom Cosmos Robe."


Adjustments

 Adjust the maximum limit for carrying Pets and Puru to 10 slots.

 Adjust the Map: Autumn Plain to Duskspire Ridge for the gold drop rate of small monsters.

 Optimize the animation effects for Pet and Puru evolution and refinement processes.

 Adjust the Danxia Woodland Quest "LV60. Soul Banner (Daily)" quest process method.  
※ After adjustment, monsters will no longer drop quest Items. If players have accepted but not yet completed the quest, they must Abandon Quest and retake it.


For detailed version update content, please refer to Notice from Official Site

notes.title: ⚠️Apr 16 (Wed) NEW PATCH UPDATE Notice ⚠️
notes.notes:
PATCH UPDATE
Game Update

 Hero Dungeons 'Hero: Quicksand Garden' and 'Hero: Sand Spirit Sanctuary' are now open. Lv60 players have four chances per day to talk to the Spring Jade City NPC 'Bear Paw Explorer - Benya' to enter the hero dungeon. In the hero dungeon, obtain [Lv60 Golden Firmament Shard], which can be exchanged with NPC 'Bear Paw Explorer - Flamel' for exclusive golden-quality sets for each second advancement class.

 Added a nearby resurrection feature in multiplayer dungeons. Each time you enter a dungeon, you have 2 chances to revive directly at the entrance of the multiplayer dungeon upon character death.


Bug Fixes:

 Fixed the issue where pet and Pulu skills with the same effect could not stack.  

 Fixed abnormal player count under certain conditions in the Snow Corridor Arena.

 Fixed the issue where players could not re-enter the battlefield after leaving midway.

 Fixed the main quest 'LV60. Escort the King to Find Balan' where the report NPC might not appear.


Adjustments

 Adjusted and optimized text display issues in various interfaces.

 Adjusted the position of special effect titles so their height will no longer be blocked by the title name or guild name.

 Optimized the TIP descriptions for 'Hundred Refined Spring (Pet Refinement)' and 'Pet Rebirth Potion.'


For detailed version update content, please refer to Notice from Official Site

notes.title: ⚠️Apr 9 (Wed) NEW PATCH UPDATE Notice ⚠️
notes.notes:
PATCH UPDATE
Game Update

 The Snowhall Arena "3v3 Mode" is now open. Players above level 50 can form a party or register solo. Battles can be accessed via the battlefield button on the radar map daily from 16:00~16:30 and 21:00~21:30. Each side starts with a battle flag in their respective starting region. Destroying the opponent's battle flag and returning to your starting region with the "Battle Flag State" grants 1 point. The first team to score 2 points wins. Each member of the winning team receives 5 Stellar Combat Tokens, while the lose one receive 3 Stellar Combat Tokens.

 Added Support Helper feature 【Cancel the second confirmation for selling high-quality Items in the Store】, can be set in the Pet tab.


Bug Fixes:

 Fixed an issue where skill effects persisted after logging out and back in while pets were fused or in Puru resonance state.  

 Fixed an issue where pet experiment attempts displayed abnormally after ceasing nurturing in the Pet Nursery.

 Fixed an issue where the Hao Xiang Tu title 【Rabbit Doctor】 incorrectly increased critical value instead of critical damage.

 Fixed an issue where switching servers did not retain Couple Channel messages.


Adjustments

 Adjusted Sandswept Wasteland battlefield capacity to 250VS250.

 Opened Elite Monster Training Hall and related quests.

 Adjusted Hao Xiang Tu series title item format and added ability descriptions.

 Adjusted Newbie Seven-Day Reward details and removed Hao Xiang Tu event-related items.
※ For characters that have already completed this, an interface reappearing is a known issue; inability to claim rewards again is normal.


For detailed version update content, please refer to Notice from Official Site

notes.title: ⚠️Apr 2 (Wed) NEW PATCH UPDATE Notice ⚠️
notes.notes:
PATCH UPDATE
Game Update

 Unlock the large-scale battlefield "Sandswept Wasteland," available daily from 20:00~20:30, 23:30~00:00, and on weekends from 14:30~15:00.

 Added the arrival of Seven-Skydemon - Obliteration Skydemon and Nine-Tailed Fox. 

 Added automatic instance reset function: 


Bug Fixes:

 Fixed the issue in the quest "LV44. Relic. Retrieval" where multiple quest monsters could be repeatedly summoned.  

 Fixed the issue where, when the character's inventory slots were full, successfully using "Pet Feed" to capture would not drop a Pet Egg.

 Fixed the issue where the same skill effects of Pets and Puru could not stack.

 Fixed the abnormal display of Guild statue appearances.

 Fixed the issue in the Auction House where certain phrases could not search for items.

 Fixed an issue under certain conditions where Puru Park would produce Purus with abnormal values and evaluations, and corrected the abnormal Puru values and evaluations on existing players' accounts.


Adjustments

 Optimized the description for pets in egg form to display the remaining experiment attempts and successful attempts for that pet. 

 Optimized the description and quantity display of Angel Coins on the left side of the Angel Gacha Machine, distinguishing between "Tradable" or "Bound" Angel Coins currently in use, with priority given to using "Bound" Angel Coins.

 Added costume items to the Collection Album, including costumes obtained from previous events and quests.


For detailed version update content, please refer to Notice from Official Site

notes.title: ⚠️Mar 26 (Wed) NEW PATCH UPDATE Notice ⚠️
notes.notes:
PATCH UPDATE
Game Update

 Level Cap Increase: 60

 New Map Added: Fire Kingdom with its three associated scenes, main quests, achievements, and recommended events.  

 New Daily Dungeon "Revenge of the Sandsea Beasts" added. Players above Lv51 can talk to the local Autonomous Defense Team NPC in Ancient Sandsea (X:111, Y:302) to enter the dungeon. 
※ The dungeon "Jadewood Forest's Crisis" has been adjusted back to its original level restriction of 41~50.

A new Achievement Badge Purple Gear Blueprint Merchant has been added, allowing players to redeem purple gear blueprints for classes ranging from level 50~60. 


Bug Fixes:

 Fixed an issue with the skill 【Dark Matter Explosion】 for Cosmos second advancement where its effect was abnormal.  

 Fixed an issue where some crossbow blueprints could not be used by Astrologer class.

 Fixed an issue where interface countdown timers would remain after leaving a house banquet.

 Fixed an issue where incorrect numbers were displayed in Collection Album at specific point values.

 Fixed an issue where both success and failure results during item synthesis played the same sound effect.

 Fixed an issue where the system display option 【Others' Damage】 was not functioning properly.

 Fixed an issue with the quest "LV47 Defeat Enemy Commander" where mission monsters could not be summoned under certain conditions.


Adjustments

 Adjusted character deletion limit; only up to two characters can be deleted within three days.

 Optimized inventory sorting functionality; clicking the auto-sort button in the inventory interface will now sort items by type.

 World Boss: Seven-Skydemon and Giant Beast series reward mechanisms adjusted.

 In response to the level cap increase, Seven-Skydemon's abilities have been significantly enhanced—please take note!

Adjusted Pet Search Squad quest requirements and rewards


For detailed version update content, please refer to Notice from Official Site

notes.title: ⚠️Mar 19 (Wed) NEW PATCH UPDATE Notice ⚠️
notes.notes:
PATCH UPDATE
Game Update

 Level Cap: 55 

 Unlock Spirit Bunny Clan Classes: Guard, Sorcerer, Warlock  

 Unlock Crystalline Tundra, Pale Moon Forest, and Silverblood Bay, along with related quests, achievements, and daily recommended activities. 

Unlock Instances (Solo, 5-player): Crystalline Tundra Instance, Pale Moon Forest Instance, Silverblood Bay Instance  

 Unlock Jadewood Forest Unparalleled Instance  

 Unlock Guild Island


Bug Fixes:

 Characters can remain in their original position when switching servers or logging out and back in.  

 Fixed the effects of second-tier mastery skills.

 Pets/Puru can now gain experience in party formation scenarios.

 Names with more than six full-width characters can now properly receive whispers.

 Polearms can now display their appearance normally.

 Fixed button deformation and position errors after resizing the channel interface.

 Fixed abnormal display of the house banquet buff after leaving the house.

 Transformation SP can now accumulate up to 1000 normally.

 Fixed the Couple Teleport skill.

 Potion merchants now stock level-55 HP and MP Potions—head over and purchase them right away!


Adjustments

 Adjusted the probability of the "Pet Rebirth Potion" improving pet quality: Green to Blue is 2%, Blue to Purple is 1%, and Purple to Gold is 0.5%.

 Added Astrologer to the Robe series equipment and Crossbow series blueprints.

 The Inspiration of the Shield of Glory costume rewards can now be stored in the collection book.

 If you possess a Teleport Feather, you can use the Map (M) to seek target monsters or NPCs, then click on the pin to teleport to that location.


For detailed version update content, please refer to Notice from Official Site
